programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: John Rambo's ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history. We test the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also see on Captain America: Winter Soldier). Additionally, for one of our larger tests - can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a minigun? Actor Bill Duke - who co-starred with Arnold Schwarzenegger for the film and who's character performed this weapon stunt - join us to find out. But first, we have to build a jungle.

programme.desc: Charlie Summerville's build project gets off to a shaky start when the helicopter transporting his crew goes missing. As Pat and Connie Harvie prep their mega ranch for sale, new engineer Donovan Judd faces his first challenge when the ranch's water supply fails. In False Pass, Stephen Kennedy and his family install a vital domestic upgrade.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: Legendary Illinois Whitetail with Stan Potts
programme.desc: Today on North American Whitetail, we join Stan Potts as he shares another exciting rut hunt in his favorite Illinois honey hole. On Build Your Own Deer Factory, we look at the PTO Tiller and the advantages and disadvantages of using them from Dr. James Kroll. Our Associate Editor, Blake Garlock, shows us how he practices for fast-action bowhunting scenarios on From the Stand, and Haynes Shelton goes back to the Iowa Deer Classic to profile the Brian Stevens Buck.
